plugins.description: Switzerland orthophoto, 10 cm (swisstopo); permitted for tracing in OSM.

plugins.name: PDOK Luchtfoto
plugins.description: Netherlands aerial imagery (PDOK, current, high resolution); permitted for tracing in OSM.

plugins.name: Yandex Panoramas
plugins.description: Yandex street panoramas in a floating window: tick the layer and click a street. Yandex permitted the imagery for OSM (not the data drawn over it).

plugins.name: Esri World Elevation
plugins.description: Esri World Elevation 3D terrain as an alternative to Mapterhorn for 3D terrain, hillshade and contours (choose it under 3D terrain in settings). View only: the heights are not used in edits.
